    if exists(select 1
      from public.weekly_exceptional_pay_target_families family
      join public.contracts contract on contract.id=family.contract_id and contract.client_id=v_work.client_id
      join public.weekly_exceptional_pay_generations generation
        on generation.id=family.current_generation_id and generation.family_id=family.id
      where family.candidate_id=v_work.candidate_id
        and v_work.work_date between family.week_start_date and family.week_ending_date
        and generation.lifecycle_state='PUBLISHED'
        and ((generation.complete_next_vector_json->>'schema_version'='WEEKLY_PROTECTED_TARGET_VECTOR_V1'

            when jsonb_typeof(generation.complete_next_vector_json#>'{target_snapshot,actual_schedule_json}')='array'
            then generation.complete_next_vector_json#>'{target_snapshot,actual_schedule_json}' else '[]'::jsonb end) item
            where item->>'work_event_id'=v_work.id::text and item->>'protected_target_state'='WAIT'))
          or (generation.complete_next_vector_json->>'schema_version'='WEEKLY_PROTECTED_NEXT_TARGET_V1'

            when jsonb_typeof(generation.complete_next_vector_json->'components')='array'
            then generation.complete_next_vector_json->'components' else '[]'::jsonb end) item
            where item->>'kind'='WORK' and item->>'work_event_id'=v_work.id::text and item->'protected'='true'::jsonb)))
